text: Hello again!
Today, we mix big friend adding and big friend taking away — in one big game!
Let's remember everything first.
Adding: one formula for every friend.
Plus one, plus two, plus three, all the way to plus nine.
Taking away: same friends, same idea, just the other way round.
Minus one, all the way to minus nine.
Eighteen formulas.
You know them all.
Now let's see if you remember them — mixed up, and fast!
It is time to Beat the Beads!
I will spin the wheel.
It will land on a number and a trick — adding, or taking away.
You tell me that number's friend, before I count to three.
If the beads get stuck, you will know exactly what to do.
Let's find out who remembers best.
Round one — spin the wheel!
It lands on plus four.
Make thirty-seven, then try to add four more.
Look at that — no room left!
Quick — what is four's friend?
Four's friend is six!
Plus four equals minus six, plus ten.
Thirty-seven plus four is forty-one!
Round two — spin the wheel!
It lands on minus seven.
Make eighty-one, then try to take away seven.
Uh oh, we are stuck!
Think fast — what is seven's friend?
Seven's friend is three!
Minus seven equals plus three, minus ten.
Eighty-one take away seven is seventy-four!
Round three — spin the wheel!
It lands on plus eight.
Make sixty-three, then try to add eight more.
Stuck again?
Let's fix that.
Here it comes — what is eight's friend?
Eight's friend is two!
Plus eight equals minus two, plus ten.
Sixty-three plus eight is seventy-one!
Round four — spin the wheel!
It lands on minus two.
Make fifty, then try to take away two.
Nothing there at all — not one bead!
Can you get this one?
What is two's friend?
Two's friend is eight!
Minus two equals plus eight, minus ten.
Fifty take away two is forty-eight!
Four down, four to go — you are mixing it up like a pro!
If you are having fun, tap that like button.
The wheel keeps mixing adding and taking away — you never know what is coming next!
Round five — spin the wheel!
It lands on plus five.
Make sixty-eight, then try to add five more.
We are stuck, but we know just what to do.
You know this one — what is five's friend?
Five's friend is five!
Plus five equals minus five, plus ten.
Sixty-eight plus five is seventy-three!
Round six — spin the wheel!
It lands on minus three.
Make sixty-two, then try to take away three.
Stuck!
Good thing we have a trick.
What is three's friend?
Tell me!
Three's friend is seven!
Minus three equals plus seven, minus ten.
Sixty-two take away three is fifty-nine!
Round seven — spin the wheel!
It lands on plus six.
Make twenty-nine, then try to add six more.
Here we go again — no room!
You remember this one — what is six's friend?
Six's friend is four!
Plus six equals minus four, plus ten.
Twenty-nine plus six is thirty-five!
Round eight — spin the wheel!
It lands on minus nine.
Make ninety-six, then try to take away nine.
One more stuck moment to solve!
Last one — what is nine's friend?
Nine's friend is one!
Minus nine equals plus one, minus ten.
Ninety-six take away nine is eighty-seven!
You just beat all eight big friend formulas!
Adding and taking away, all mixed up, and you got every one.
Nine formulas each way, and now you have played with both.
Try Beat the Beads on your own abacus at home.
For more sums to practice, search for Abacus Kids on the Apple App Store or Google Play.
Download it free.
Next time, we will meet a brand new kind of trick — one that adds and takes away, both at once.
See you next time!
